neighbours.label: Left-context predictor of a decision verb: the slot after 'help you', 'has one month to', 'make any final', where 'decide' or 'decision' is the likely next word, whatever actually follows
fire: This comparison chart should help you pick the right tent for your trip.
The jury has three days to reach a verdict in the case.
Read the small print before you make any major commitments.
The board will have to settle the matter at its next meeting.
It is entirely up to you whether to accept the offer.
These sample photos can help buyers choose between the two lenses.
The council now has until Friday to vote on the new zoning plan.
Ask the pharmacist before you make any changes to your dosage.

predictions: Frames that set up 'decide/decision/choice' as the next word reach 0.3-0.6 even when the continuation differs; sentences on the same topics with no such setup stay under 0.15. The probe showed near-identical scores for 'help you decide' and 'help you understand', so the test's near misses remove the frame, not the word.
notes: Probe: 'help you decide which' 0.551 (peak ' you') and 'help you understand how' 0.551 (same peak); 'one month to decide' 0.388 = 'one month to prepare' 0.388; 'make any final decisions' 0.405 (peak ' final'); 'bases its decision' 0.166 = 'bases its estimate' 0.166; 'help interested customers make the right choice' 0.186; river flood 0.008. The output direction suppresses ' choice', ' choose', ' choosing', so the pole predicts the 'decide' family and steers against 'choice'. Card peaks ' his', ' you', ' to', ' me', ' final' right before decision/decide/becoming involved.
